description:
## What to do

Adapt the upstream RPC doc (tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/docs/rpc.md, 1407 lines) for our Elixir system.

## Upstream source

- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/docs/rpc.md
- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/rpc-types.ts
- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/rpc-mode.ts
- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/rpc-client.ts

## Output

Create docs/rpc.md

## How to adapt

This is a very long doc (1407 lines). Structure it in these sections:

### 1. Overview
Document our `mix pi --mode rpc` command. The protocol is identical (JSONL over stdin/stdout) since it is a wire protocol, not an implementation detail.

### 2. Protocol Overview
Preserve verbatim:
- JSONL framing (LF delimiter)
- Commands → Responses flow
- Events streaming
- The warning about Node readline not being protocol-compliant

### 3. Commands
Convert each command section:

**Prompting:**
- `prompt` — same JSON structure, update response format
- `steer` — same
- `follow_up` — same
- `abort` — same
- `new_session` — same, note our `OctoPi.Coder.SessionManager.new_session/1`

**State:**
- `get_state` — update response fields to match our `OctoPi.Coder.Session` state
- `get_messages` — same

**Model:**
- `set_model` — same
- `cycle_model` — same
- `get_available_models` — same

**Thinking:**
- `set_thinking_level` — same
- `cycle_thinking_level` — same

**Queue Modes:**
- `set_steering_mode` — same
- `set_follow_up_mode` — same

**Compaction:**
- `compact` — same
- `set_auto_compaction` — same

**Retry:**
- `set_auto_retry` — same
- `abort_retry` — same

**Bash:**
- `bash` — same
- `abort_bash` — same
- Note: BashExecutionMessage creation and next-prompt inclusion is the same concept

**Session:**
- `get_session_stats` — update response fields
- `export_html` — same
- `switch_session` — same
- `fork` — same
- `clone` — same
- `get_fork_messages` — same
- `get_last_assistant_text` — same
- `set_session_name` — same

**Commands:**
- `get_commands` — same

### 4. Events
Convert all event types to our Elixir event names. The JSON structure is identical since it is a wire protocol:
- `agent_start`, `agent_end`
- `turn_start`, `turn_end`
- `message_start`, `message_update`, `message_end`
- `tool_execution_start`, `tool_execution_update`, `tool_execution_end`
- `queue_update`
- `compaction_start`, `compaction_end`
- `auto_retry_start`, `auto_retry_end`
- `extension_error`

For `message_update`, show our `assistantMessageEvent` types:
- `start`, `text_start`, `text_delta`, `text_end`
- `thinking_start`, `thinking_delta`, `thinking_end`
- `toolcall_start`, `toolcall_delta`, `toolcall_end`
- `done`, `error`

### 5. Extension UI Protocol
Convert the dialog methods:
- `select`, `confirm`, `input`, `editor` (dialog methods with response)
- `notify`, `setStatus`, `setWidget`, `setTitle`, `set_editor_text` (fire-and-forget)

Note degraded methods in RPC mode (same as upstream).

### 6. Error Handling
Same as upstream.

### 7. Types
Convert all TypeScript types to our Elixir equivalents:
- `Model` → `OctoPi.AI.Model`
- `UserMessage` → our user message format
- `AssistantMessage` → our assistant message format
- `ToolResultMessage` → our tool result format
- `BashExecutionMessage` → our bash execution format
- `Attachment` → our attachment format

## What to preserve verbatim

- The JSONL framing rules
- All command JSON structures (wire protocol is identical)
- All event JSON structures
- The extension UI request/response protocol
- The error response format

## Key upstream references to include

- [rpc-types.ts](https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/rpc-types.ts)
- [rpc-mode.ts](https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/rpc-mode.ts)

## Testing the doc

After writing, verify:
1. All command names match our actual RPC commands
2. All event names match our actual events
3. The JSON structures are accurate
4. The types match our actual structs
